title: COGS: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Attribute-Aware Object-Level 3D Gaussian Splatting Perception
summary: On capture-derived MACGS, all six conventional backbones have an attribute subset outperforming full POSQC by 0.28–3.05 points, while both HALO variants do best with full inputs. Six conventional classifiers and two HALO variants are evaluated on COGS and capture-derived MACGS; subset selection and dataset-specific architecture effects remain bounded.
